job_description:
We are hiring an AI/ML and MLOps Field Engineer to help global companies embrace AI in their business, using the latest open source capabilities on public and private cloud infrastructure, Linux and Kubernetes. Our team applies expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, Kubeflow, MLFlow, Feast, DVC and related analytics, machine learning and data technologies. We are working to create the world's best open source data platform, covering traditional SQL databases and today's NoSQL data stores, as well as the machinery which turns data into insights and executable models.

The people who love this role are software engineers who enjoy customer conversations and solving customer problems during the presales cycle. They are are developers who like to solve customer problems through architecture, presentations and training. Ubuntu is used by pretty much every enterprise in the world, in every industry. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about the open source technology landscape and develop your business technology insights. You will see first hand in various industries how Linux - and Ubuntu in particular - is shaping innovation and changing the world for the better.

This role is particularly suited to candidates with a technical background who are business minded and driven by commercial success. This role is on our global Field Engineering team and will work closely with enterprise sales leads. Training LLMs on multiple K8s clusters deployed on a hybrid cloud infrastructure with GPU sharing across multiple teams? Processing 10M events in real time for financial transactions? At the SEI AI Division, we conduct research in applied artificial intelligence and the engineering questions related to the practical design and implementation of AI technologies and systems. Leading Development and Delivery of Training: You will lead the creation of courses and curricula, defining learning objectives to developing course materials and teaching. Are you a seasoned professional with a strong research background in Cryptography and Artificial Intelligence, who is passionate about Web3 technologies. We are on a hunt for a core team member with a strong technical background to embark on an exhilarating journey.

About us:

Satori is an innovative AI-powered Knowledge Tree Protocol aimed at revolutionizing Web3 developer education. It addresses the challenges in Web3 education, such as the complexity of decentralized technologies, the need for updated and practical learning materials, and the lack of standardized educational paths and community support. Its innovative application layer and tech framework employ a natural, intuitive Knowledge Tree structure to document information and data efficiently, optimized by AI for dynamic content management and tailored learning experiences.

The role:

We are seeking a seasoned professional with a strong research background and prior coding experience in Web3.0 and Artificial Intelligence, who is experienced and passionated about Web3 technologies. As a co-founder of the project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the educational landscape of Web3. Your expertise will contribute to the development of our Knowledge Tree Protocol, ensuring that it remains cutting-edge and effective for our users.

Your Responsibilities, should you choose to accept:

- Conduct in-depth research focused on integrating AI with Knowledge Tree methodologies, focusing specifically on how artificial intelligence (AI) can revolutionize data organization, learning paths, and content delivery within this framework.

- Act as the chief architect for the AI-powered Knowledge Tree Protocol, designing its core framework to ensure scalability and effectiveness within the Web3 ecosystem.

- Lead the engineering team in developing robust AI models and protocols, ensuring they align with the latest Web3 innovations and industry standards.

- Oversee the creation and implementation of smart contracts, contributing to the development of secure and efficient Web 3.0 infrastructure.

- Drive continuous improvement in our platform by staying at the forefront of technological advances, leveraging insights from the Web3 community to guide development strategy.

Qualifications:

- PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cryptography, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

-Prior experience in building web3 protocol is a must, good understanding of smart contract development and web 3.0 infrastructure

- Proven research and development experience in Cryptography and AI, with a strong portfolio of relevant projects.

- Deep technical expertise and a keen interest in Web3 technologies and education.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.

- Be part of a passionate and innovative team dedicated to transforming Web3 education.

- Access to a network of industry experts, investors, and mentors to accelerate our growth.

- Flexible working hours and remote work opportunities.
